violation_type.title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)
violation_type.typical_finding: The smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detectors have not been inspected monthly.

finding_variants.text: The smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detectors have not been inspected monthly.
The smoke detectors had not been inspected. The detector was tested during the inspection and was in working order.
At inspection, the operation did not have documentation of monthly smoke and CO2 testing for January of 2026.
Documentation was unavailable for the month of January and February of 2022 on the emergency practices.    NOTE: This was corrected when maintenance verified the dates.
There was no documentation showing the smoke detector had bee tested.
Smoke Detector Testing is not being conducted monthly. The last test recorded was for the month of May 2023.
